candidates.paper_location: arXiv:2407.10381 §VII.C.2 'Compilation of Entangling Gates between Physical Qubits' / 'Two-Qubit Entangling Gates', eq:RZZ (+ eq:beamsplitter_conjugation remark); label verified present in source
candidates.insight: CANDIDATE 1: kind=pauli; source=§VII.C.2 "Two-Qubit Entangling Gates", Eq. (RZZ) R_ZZ(θ)=D_c^{(1,2)}(-iα,+iα)D_c^{(1,1)}(α,-α)D_c^{(1,2)}(+iα,-iα)D_c^{(1,1)}(-α,α), θ=4α² (with the beam-splitter-conjugation remark of Eq. beamsplitter_conjugation showing the "remote" CD is just a CD between an ancilla mode and whichever qubit is addressed); insight=The paper's two-qubit gate is built from *two* conditional displacements on a *single shared ancilla mode*, one controlled by each qubit, forming a closed phase-space loop whose enclosed area is proportional to Z1Z2 — algebraically this is exactly our native `CD(alpha,q,md)` gate applied twice per qubit, so on our ISA (where CD already connects *any* qubit to *any* mode) the beam-splitter SWAP network the paper needs for its fixed local connectivity is unnecessary, collapsing the gate to 4 hybrid CD ops total instead of the existing rule's 8 CR/CP ops; the net oscillator displacement sums to exactly zero for every joint qubit eigenvalue so the ancilla provably returns to vacuum (certified exact), and basis changes (H for X, Sdg·H for Y) reduce XX/YY to the same ZZ loop at the cost of a few extra 1-op gates; sign of theta is handled by taking the Hermitian conjugate (reverse order + negate amplitudes) of the θ≥0 sequence.

candidates.insight: CANDIDATE 1: kind=pauli_hop; source=arXiv:2407.10381 §VII.C.1 "Synthesizing Hybrid Oscillator-Qubit Gates", Eq. (cparity_conj) and Eq. (cond_disp_compilation) [the $Z\to P$ conjugation identity], combined with the existing `rule_z_hop__cp_conj` CP/BS/CR sequence; insight=For any unitary $V$ on the ancilla with $VZV^\dagger=P$, $V\,e^{-i\theta Z(\text{op})}\,V^\dagger = e^{-i\theta P(\text{op})}$ exactly, since $V$ acts only on the qubit wire and commutes with the mode operator — so sandwiching the certified `z_hop` sequence with $H$ (for $X$, since $HZH=X$) or with $H$ then $S$ (for $Y$, since $S(HZH)S^\dagger=Y$) gives an exact rule for weight-1 Pauli-hop with zero added entangling gates, only 2 (X) or 4 (Y) extra 1-op gates.
candidates.code_initial:
def rule_pauli_hop__basis_conj(t, g, r):
    if t.label == 'X':
        g.h(t.q[0])
        g.CP(t.q[0], t.m[1])
        g.BS(2 * t.theta, t.phi + m.pi / 2, t.m[0], t.m[1])
        g.CR(-m.pi, t.q[0], t.m[1])
        g.h(t.q[0])
    elif t.label == 'Y':
        g.sdg(t.q[0])
        g.h(t.q[0])
        g.CP(t.q[0], t.m[1])
        g.BS(2 * t.theta, t.phi + m.pi / 2, t.m[0], t.m[1])
        g.CR(-m.pi, t.q[0], t.m[1])
        g.h(t.q[0])
        g.s(t.q[0])
    else:
        g.CP(t.q[0], t.m[1])
        g.BS(2 * t.theta, t.phi + m.pi / 2, t.m[0], t.m[1])
        g.CR(-m.pi, t.q[0], t.m[1])
